<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Wayfinder — Office Directory</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#12161c;
    --panel:#1a2029;
    --panel-2:#161b23;
    --line:#3a4553;
    --text:#eef1f5;
    --text-dim:#93a0b0;
    --you:#f2a93b;
    --dest:#ff6f59;
    --core:#4fd1c5;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  body{
    background:var(--ink);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding:28px 20px 60px;
  }
  .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;}

  header{margin-bottom:24px;}
  h1{
    font-family:"Bahnschrift","DIN Alternate","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0.4px;
    font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,36px);
    margin:0;
  }
  header p{
    margin:8px 0 0;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    font-size:15px;
    max-width:62ch;
    line-height:1.5;
  }

  .panel{
    background:var(--panel);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius:10px;
  }

  .controls{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto;
    gap:16px;
    padding:20px;
    margin-bottom:22px;
    align-items:end;
  }
  @media (max-width:820px){ .controls{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .field-group{
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:14px 16px 16px;
    background:var(--panel-2);
  }
  .field-group h2{
    margin:0 0 12px;
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:0.6px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    font-family:"Bahnschrift","DIN Alternate","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
  }
  .field-group.you h2::before{content:"● "; color:var(--you);}
  .field-group.go h2::before{content:"● "; color:var(--dest);}

  label{display:block; font-size:12px; color:var(--text-dim); margin:10px 0 4px;}
  label:first-of-type{margin-top:0;}
  select{
    width:100%;
    background:var(--ink);
    color:var(--text);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:9px 10px;
    font-size:14.5px;
    font-family:inherit;
  }
  select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--core); outline-offset:1px;}

  button.go-btn{
    background:var(--core);
    color:#06231f;
    border:none;
    border-radius:8px;
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:700;
    padding:14px 26px;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-family:"Bahnschrift","DIN Alternate","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
    letter-spacing:0.3px;
    height:fit-content;
  }
  button.go-btn:hover{background:#6fe0d4;}
  button.go-btn:active{transform:scale(0.97);}
  @media (max-width:820px){ button.go-btn{width:100%;} }

  .steps{ display:none; padding:16px 20px; margin-bottom:22px; }
  .steps.show{display:block;}
  .steps h2{
    margin:0 0 10px;
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:0.6px;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    font-family:"Bahnschrift","DIN Alternate","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
  }
  .steps ol{ margin:0; padding-left:20px; line-height:1.7; font-size:15px; }
  .steps .same-msg{ font-size:15px; color:var(--core); }

  .maps{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:14px; }
  .maps.dual{ grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; }
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .maps.dual{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  }

  .map-card{ padding:16px; }
  .map-card .floor-label{
    font-family:"Bahnschrift","DIN Alternate","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.5px;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    margin:0 0 10px;
  }
  .plan-stage{ position:relative; width:100%; background:#fff; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; }
  .plan-stage img{ display:block; width:100%; height:auto; }
  .plan-stage svg{ position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; }

  .pin{ position:absolute; transform:translate(-50%,-100%); text-align:center; }
  .pin .dot{
    width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%;
    border:2px solid #1a2029;
    margin:0 auto;
    box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .pin.you .dot{ background:var(--you); }
  .pin.dest .dot{ background:var(--dest); }
  .pin.you{ color:var(--you); }
  .pin.dest{ color:var(--dest); }
  .pin .tag{
    font-family:"Bahnschrift","DIN Alternate","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
    font-size:12px; font-weight:700;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.72);
    color:#fff;
    padding:2px 6px;
    border-radius:4px;
    white-space:nowrap;
    display:inline-block;
    margin-bottom:3px;
  }
  .pin .ring{
    position:absolute; left:50%; top:0; width:16px; height:16px;
    transform:translate(-50%,0);
    border-radius:50%;
    border:2px solid var(--you);
    animation:pulse 1.8s ease-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse{
    0%{ transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1); opacity:0.7; }
    100%{ transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(2.4); opacity:0; }
  }

  .route-line{ fill:none; stroke:#2f6fed; stroke-width:2.6; stroke-dasharray:8 6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
  .route-line.outline{ stroke:#fff; stroke-width:5.5; stroke-dasharray:none; opacity:0.85; }

  .connector{
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    padding:0 6px; color:var(--core);
    font-family:"Bahnschrift","DIN Alternate","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
    font-size:12px; text-align:center; min-width:70px;
  }
  .connector .dash{ width:0; height:70px; border-left:2px dashed var(--core); }
  .connector .badge{
    background:#12312e; border:1px solid var(--core); border-radius:50%;
    width:44px;height:44px; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; font-size:20px;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .connector{ flex-direction:row; justify-content:center; padding:10px 0; }
    .connector .dash{ width:60px; height:0; border-top:2px dashed var(--core); border-left:none; }
  }

  .legend{ display:flex; gap:22px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:18px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--text-dim); }
  .legend span{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
  .legend i{ width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block; }
  .legend .line-sample{ width:20px; height:0; border-top:2.6px dashed #2f6fed; border-radius:0; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <header>
    <h1>Wayfinder</h1>
    <p>Pick where you are and where you're headed — it'll mark both spots on the floor plan and trace the route along the hallway to get there.</p>
  </header>

  <div class="controls panel">
    <div class="field-group you">
      <h2>You are</h2>
      <label for="you-floor">Floor</label>
      <select id="you-floor"></select>
      <label for="you-room">At</label>
      <select id="you-room"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="field-group go">
      <h2>Going to</h2>
      <label for="go-floor">Floor</label>
      <select id="go-floor"></select>
      <label for="go-room">Room</label>
      <select id="go-room"></select>
    </div>
    <button class="go-btn" id="route-btn">Show me the way</button>
  </div>

  <div class="steps panel" id="steps-panel">
    <h2>Directions</h2>
    <div id="steps-content"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="maps" id="maps-container"></div>

  <div class="legend">
    <span><i style="background:var(--you)"></i> You are here</span>
    <span><i style="background:var(--dest)"></i> Destination</span>
    <span><i style="background:var(--core)"></i> Stairs / Elevator</span>
    <span><span class="line-sample"></span> Route (via hallway)</span>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
/* ---------- floor plan images (the original drawings) ---------- */
var IMG1 = "data:image/png;base64,"; /* Floor 1 */
var IMG2 = "data:image/png;base64,"; /* Floor 2 */

/*
  Each room has x,y = the pixel location of its label in the ORIGINAL image.
  `via` is the ordered list of waypoints a route must pass through to get
  from this room out to the main hallway line (nearest point first). Every
  via chain ends exactly on the floor's hallway line (y === hallwayY),
  so two rooms' via-chains can always be joined by a straight run along
  the hallway itself, instead of a route cutting through walls/rooms.
*/
function room(id,label,x,y,group,via){
  return {id:id, label:label===undefined?id:label, x:x, y:y, group:group||'room', via:via||null};
}

/* ---------- FLOOR 1 ---------- */
/* Hallway: horizontal band at y=140, running under the top rooms and past
   the reception/stairs branch. The stairs/elevator/front desk area hangs
   off a single vertical branch corridor at x=600. */
var F1_HALLWAY_Y = 140;
var F1_BRANCH_X = 600;

function f1DirectVia(x){ return [{x:x, y:F1_HALLWAY_Y}]; }
function f1BranchVia(y){ return [{x:F1_BRANCH_X, y:y}, {x:F1_BRANCH_X, y:F1_HALLWAY_Y}]; }

var FLOOR1 = {
  id:1, name:"Floor 1", img:IMG1, w:770, h:323,
  hallwayY:F1_HALLWAY_Y,
  rooms:[
    room("121","121",100,88,"room",f1DirectVia(100)),
    room("120","120",163,88,"room",f1DirectVia(163)),
    room("119","119",222,88,"room",f1DirectVia(222)),
    room("118","118",285,88,"room",f1DirectVia(285)),
    room("117","117",345,88,"room",f1DirectVia(345)),
    room("116","116",405,88,"room",f1DirectVia(405)),
    room("111","111",475,60,"room",f1DirectVia(475)),
    room("110","110",513,60,"room",f1DirectVia(513)),
    room("109","109",555,60,"room",f1DirectVia(555)),
    room("108","108",598,60,"room",f1DirectVia(598)),
    room("113","113",478,98,"room",f1DirectVia(478)),
    room("114","114",513,118,"room",f1DirectVia(513)),
    room("115","115",478,138,"room",f1DirectVia(478)),
    room("107","107",600,100,"room",f1DirectVia(600)),
    room("conf","Conference Room",545,120,"room",f1DirectVia(545)),
    room("restrooms-1","Restrooms",670,68,"amenity",f1DirectVia(670)),
    room("front-desk","Front Desk",605,163,"amenity",f1BranchVia(163)),
    room("stairs-1","Stairs",548,255,"core",f1BranchVia(255)),
    room("elevator-1","Elevator",578,272,"core",f1BranchVia(272))
  ]
};

/* ---------- FLOOR 2 ---------- */
/* There are TWO separate hallway systems on this floor:
     - the OUTER hallway at y=215, which the pods hang off at the top,
       and which continues right into the open 204/777/Client Lounge/
       Breakroom/Stairs/Elevator cluster (that whole cluster is one
       continuous open corridor area reached via the vertical run at x=705).
     - the MIDDLE hallway at y=298, which runs between the two facing
       rows of "200" rooms (238-219 above it, 216-207 below it) - every
       200-numbered room opens directly onto THIS hallway, not the outer
       one.
   The only way between the two hallway systems is through a few open
   pass-throughs, at roughly x=15 (far left, by the secondary stair), 203
   and 427 (the wider gaps in the upper room row), and 705 (where the
   200 rooms give way to the open cluster on the right). Routing between
   a "200" room and anything on the outer hallway (a pod, Stairs,
   Elevator, 204, etc.) has to detour sideways to the nearest of those
   pass-throughs before it can change hallway level. */
var F2_OUTER_Y = 215;
var F2_MID_Y = 298;
var F2_RIGHT_CORRIDOR_X = 705;
var F2_PASSTHROUGHS = [15, 203, 427, 705];

function nearestPassthrough(x){
  return F2_PASSTHROUGHS.reduce(function(best,c){
    return Math.abs(c-x) < Math.abs(best-x) ? c : best;
  });
}

function f2OuterVia(x){ return [{x:x, y:F2_OUTER_Y}]; }
function f2MidVia(x){ return [{x:x, y:F2_MID_Y}]; }
/* The right-hand corridor (x=705) is one continuous open run from the
   outer hallway all the way down past the middle-hallway level to the
   Stairs/Elevator - so a room hanging off it should join the MIDDLE
   hallway directly (no need to detour up to the outer hallway and back
   down again just to cross that same open stretch). It only needs the
   outer hallway when the other end of a route is a pod. */
function f2RightVia(y){ return [{x:F2_RIGHT_CORRIDOR_X, y:y}, {x:F2_RIGHT_CORRIDOR_X, y:F2_MID_Y}]; }

var FLOOR2 = {
  id:2, name:"Floor 2", img:IMG2, w:928, h:593,
  hallwayY:F2_MID_Y,
  passthroughs:F2_PASSTHROUGHS,
  rooms:[
    room("E190","E190",100,105,"pod",f2OuterVia(100)),
    room("737-2","737 #2",222,100,"pod",f2OuterVia(222)),
    room("E170","E170",475,100,"pod",f2OuterVia(475)),
    room("737-1","737 #1",723,90,"pod",f2OuterVia(723)),
    room("320-1","320 #1",855,95,"pod",f2OuterVia(855)),

    room("238","238",62,262,"room",f2MidVia(62)),
    room("237","237",107,262,"room",f2MidVia(107)),
    room("236","236",144,262,"room",f2MidVia(144)),
    room("234","234",207,265,"room",f2MidVia(207)),
    room("233","233",233,265,"room",f2MidVia(233)),
    room("232","232",258,265,"room",f2MidVia(258)),
    room("231","231",302,265,"room",f2MidVia(302)),
    room("229","229",380,268,"room",f2MidVia(380)),
    room("229b","229",440,268,"room",f2MidVia(440)),
    room("227","227",470,268,"room",f2MidVia(470)),
    room("226","226",497,268,"room",f2MidVia(497)),
    room("225","225",522,268,"room",f2MidVia(522)),
    room("223","223",581,265,"room",f2MidVia(581)),
    room("222","222",612,265,"room",f2MidVia(612)),
    room("221","221",652,265,"room",f2MidVia(652)),
    room("219","219",715,265,"room",f2MidVia(715)),

    room("216","216",73,335,"room",f2MidVia(73)),
    room("215","215",129,335,"room",f2MidVia(129)),
    room("214","214",190,340,"room",f2MidVia(190)),
    room("213","213",256,340,"room",f2MidVia(256)),
    room("212","212",315,340,"room",f2MidVia(315)),
    room("211","211",380,340,"room",f2MidVia(380)),
    room("210","210",440,340,"room",f2MidVia(440)),
    room("209","209",498,340,"room",f2MidVia(498)),
    room("208","208",580,340,"room",f2MidVia(580)),
    room("207","207",637,340,"room",f2MidVia(637)),

    room("204","204",748,323,"room",f2RightVia(323)),
    room("777","777",855,305,"pod",f2RightVia(305)),
    room("203","203",728,391,"room",f2RightVia(391)),
    room("204a","204A",770,391,"room",f2RightVia(391)),
    room("client-lounge","Client Lounge",634,402,"amenity",f2RightVia(402)),
    room("breakroom","Breakroom",634,466,"amenity",f2RightVia(466)),
    room("stairs-2","Stairs",600,525,"core",[{x:790,y:525},{x:790,y:F2_MID_Y}]),
    room("elevator-2","Elevator",615,525,"core",[{x:790,y:525},{x:790,y:F2_MID_Y}])
  ]
};

var FLOORS = [FLOOR1, FLOOR2];
function getFloor(id){ return FLOORS.filter(function(f){return f.id===Number(id);})[0]; }
function getRoom(floor, roomId){ return floor.rooms.filter(function(r){return r.id===roomId;})[0]; }
function pickCore(floor){
  /* prefer the elevator as the cross-floor connector, fall back to stairs */
  return floor.rooms.filter(function(r){return r.id.indexOf('elevator')===0;})[0] ||
         floor.rooms.filter(function(r){return r.group==='core';})[0];
}

/* Build a route between two rooms on the SAME floor: room -> its via chain
   out to the hallway -> straight run along the hallway -> the other room's
   via chain, reversed, back in. Because both via chains end on the same
   hallway line, the join between them IS that straight hallway run.
   If the two rooms' via chains end on DIFFERENT hallway lines (Floor 2's
   outer hallway vs. its middle hallway), detour through the nearest
   pass-through between the two rooms first. */
function corridorPath(floor, roomA, roomB){
  var pts = [{x:roomA.x,y:roomA.y}];
  roomA.via.forEach(function(p){ pts.push(p); });

  var endA = roomA.via[roomA.via.length-1];
  var endB = roomB.via[roomB.via.length-1];
  if(endA.y !== endB.y && floor.passthroughs){
    var px = nearestPassthroughOn(floor.passthroughs, endA.x, endB.x);
    pts.push({x:px, y:endA.y});
    pts.push({x:px, y:endB.y});
  }

  roomB.via.slice().reverse().forEach(function(p){ pts.push(p); });
  pts.push({x:roomB.x,y:roomB.y});
  return pts;
}
function nearestPassthroughOn(list, xA, xB){
  var mid = (xA+xB)/2;
  return list.reduce(function(best,c){
    return Math.abs(c-mid) < Math.abs(best-mid) ? c : best;
  });
}

/* ---------- rendering: real image + overlaid pins/route ---------- */
function renderFloorStage(floor, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  var pins = '';
  ['youId','destId'].forEach(function(key){
    var id = opts[key];
    if(!id) return;
    var r = getRoom(floor, id);
    if(!r) return;
    var kind = key==='youId' ? 'you' : 'dest';
    var leftPct = (r.x/floor.w*100).toFixed(2);
    var topPct = (r.y/floor.h*100).toFixed(2);
    var ring = kind==='you' ? '<div class="ring"></div>' : '';
    pins += '<div class="pin '+kind+'" style="left:'+leftPct+'%; top:'+topPct+'%;">' +
              '<span class="tag">'+r.label+'</span>' +
              '<div class="dot" style="position:relative;">'+ring+'</div>' +
            '</div>';
  });

  var svgOverlay = '';
  if(opts.pathPts && opts.pathPts.length > 1){
    var pts = opts.pathPts.map(function(p){
      return (p.x/floor.w*100)+','+(p.y/floor.h*100);
    }).join(' ');
    svgOverlay = '<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none">' +
      '<polyline class="route-line outline" points="'+pts+'" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></polyline>' +
      '<polyline class="route-line" points="'+pts+'" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></polyline>' +
      '</svg>';
  }

  return '<div class="plan-stage">' +
           '<img src="'+floor.img+'" alt="'+floor.name+' plan">' +
           svgOverlay +
           pins +
         '</div>';
}

/* ---------- controls ---------- */
var youFloorSel = document.getElementById('you-floor');
var youRoomSel = document.getElementById('you-room');
var goFloorSel = document.getElementById('go-floor');
var goRoomSel = document.getElementById('go-room');
var mapsContainer = document.getElementById('maps-container');
var stepsPanel = document.getElementById('steps-panel');
var stepsContent = document.getElementById('steps-content');

function fillFloorSelect(sel){
  sel.innerHTML = FLOORS.map(function(f){return '<option value="'+f.id+'">'+f.name+'</option>';}).join("");
}
function fillRoomSelect(sel, floor, preferId){
  var opts = floor.rooms.slice().sort(function(a,b){
    if(a.group==='core' && b.group!=='core') return 1;
    if(b.group==='core' && a.group!=='core') return -1;
    return 0;
  });
  sel.innerHTML = opts.map(function(r){
    return '<option value="'+r.id+'">'+r.label+(r.group==='core' ? ' (Core)' : '')+'</option>';
  }).join("");
  if(preferId && floor.rooms.some(function(r){return r.id===preferId;})){
    sel.value = preferId;
  }
}

fillFloorSelect(youFloorSel);
fillFloorSelect(goFloorSel);
youFloorSel.value = 1;
goFloorSel.value = 2;
fillRoomSelect(youRoomSel, getFloor(1), "front-desk");
fillRoomSelect(goRoomSel, getFloor(2), "207");

function refreshPreview(){
  var yFloor = getFloor(youFloorSel.value);
  var gFloor = getFloor(goFloorSel.value);
  if(yFloor.id === gFloor.id){
    mapsContainer.className = 'maps';
    mapsContainer.innerHTML =
      '<div class="map-card panel">' +
        '<p class="floor-label">'+yFloor.name+'</p>' +
        renderFloorStage(yFloor, {youId:youRoomSel.value, destId:goRoomSel.value}) +
      '</div>';
  } else {
    mapsContainer.className = 'maps dual';
    mapsContainer.innerHTML =
      '<div class="map-card panel">' +
        '<p class="floor-label">'+yFloor.name+'</p>' +
        renderFloorStage(yFloor, {youId:youRoomSel.value}) +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="connector"><div class="dash"></div><div class="badge">&#8597;</div><span>Stairs /<br>Elevator</span><div class="dash"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="map-card panel">' +
        '<p class="floor-label">'+gFloor.name+'</p>' +
        renderFloorStage(gFloor, {destId:goRoomSel.value}) +
      '</div>';
  }
}

youFloorSel.addEventListener('change', function(){
  fillRoomSelect(youRoomSel, getFloor(youFloorSel.value));
  refreshPreview();
});
goFloorSel.addEventListener('change', function(){
  fillRoomSelect(goRoomSel, getFloor(goFloorSel.value));
  refreshPreview();
});
youRoomSel.addEventListener('change', refreshPreview);
goRoomSel.addEventListener('change', refreshPreview);

document.getElementById('route-btn').addEventListener('click', function(){
  var yFloor = getFloor(youFloorSel.value);
  var gFloor = getFloor(goFloorSel.value);
  var yRoom = getRoom(yFloor, youRoomSel.value);
  var gRoom = getRoom(gFloor, goRoomSel.value);

  stepsPanel.classList.add('show');

  if(yFloor.id === gFloor.id){
    if(yRoom.id === gRoom.id){
      mapsContainer.className = 'maps';
      mapsContainer.innerHTML =
        '<div class="map-card panel">' +
          '<p class="floor-label">'+yFloor.name+'</p>' +
          renderFloorStage(yFloor, {youId:yRoom.id, destId:gRoom.id}) +
        '</div>';
      stepsContent.innerHTML = '<p class="same-msg">You\'re already there — '+yRoom.label+' on '+yFloor.name+'.</p>';
      return;
    }
    var pathPts = corridorPath(yFloor, yRoom, gRoom);
    mapsContainer.className = 'maps';
    mapsContainer.innerHTML =
      '<div class="map-card panel">' +
        '<p class="floor-label">'+yFloor.name+'</p>' +
        renderFloorStage(yFloor, {youId:yRoom.id, destId:gRoom.id, pathPts:pathPts}) +
      '</div>';
    stepsContent.innerHTML =
      '<ol><li>From '+yRoom.label+', follow the hallway on '+yFloor.name+'.</li>' +
      '<li>Arrive at '+gRoom.label+'.</li></ol>';
  } else {
    var yCore = pickCore(yFloor);
    var gCore = pickCore(gFloor);
    var pathA = corridorPath(yFloor, yRoom, yCore);
    var pathB = corridorPath(gFloor, gCore, gRoom);
    var dir = Number(gFloor.id) > Number(yFloor.id) ? 'up' : 'down';

    mapsContainer.className = 'maps dual';
    mapsContainer.innerHTML =
      '<div class="map-card panel">' +
        '<p class="floor-label">'+yFloor.name+'</p>' +
        renderFloorStage(yFloor, {youId:yRoom.id, destId:yCore.id, pathPts:pathA}) +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="connector"><div class="dash"></div><div class="badge">&#8597;</div><span>Stairs /<br>Elevator</span><div class="dash"></div></div>' +
      '<div class="map-card panel">' +
        '<p class="floor-label">'+gFloor.name+'</p>' +
        renderFloorStage(gFloor, {youId:gCore.id, destId:gRoom.id, pathPts:pathB}) +
      '</div>';

    stepsContent.innerHTML =
      '<ol>' +
      '<li>From '+yRoom.label+' on '+yFloor.name+', follow the hallway to the '+yCore.label+'.</li>' +
      '<li>Go '+dir+' to '+gFloor.name+'.</li>' +
      '<li>From the '+gCore.label+', follow the hallway to '+gRoom.label+'.</li>' +
      '</ol>';
  }
});

refreshPreview();
</script>
</body>
</html>
